title: Saving Pocket Money
text:
Maya gets five dollars of pocket money every Friday. She likes to save some of it in a small box. Last month she saved twelve dollars. Now she wants to buy a new book.

Her brother Leo spends all his money on sweets at the shop. He says saving is boring. But Maya thinks that saving is useful, because it helps her buy the things she really wants.

Leo saves money and Maya spends it

vocabulary.definition: to keep money for later instead of spending it
good for doing something or helping you

paragraph_translations: A Maya recebe cinco dólares de mesada toda sexta-feira. Ela gosta de guardar parte do dinheiro em uma caixinha pequena. No mês passado, ela guardou doze dólares. Agora ela quer comprar um livro novo.
O irmão dela, Leo, gasta todo o dinheiro com doces na loja. Ele diz que guardar dinheiro é chato. Mas a Maya acha que guardar é útil, porque isso a ajuda a comprar as coisas que ela realmente quer.
